message:
The other day, we were packing our go-bags for a little family adventure. You know, just in case we needed to be ready for anything! As we rummaged through our supplies, my kiddo started insisting on bringing their beloved stuffed animal. I hesitated, thinking about space and practicality, but then I remembered how comforting that toy was during our last camping trip. 

It hit me—preparedness isn’t just about the essentials like water and snacks; it’s also about the things that bring us comfort and peace of mind. So, we made room for that little buddy in the bag. 🧸 

What’s something you’ve included in your family’s readiness plan that might seem a bit unconventional but makes all the difference?
